title: Restricted weight fixed assignment
statement: Let $n>0$, and let $a,b$ be positive natural numbers with $2a\le b$. Given a restricted-weight input with these parameters, a subset $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and a sample index in the input's outer sample range, the fixed assignment is the sign assignment on $\mathrm{Fin}(n)\setminus J$ obtained by encoding the restricted-weight fixed sample at that index as a sign cube.
hypotheses_covered: sample index lies in the outer sample range
caveat: The sampler and outer sample range are referenced but not defined in the supplied upstream descriptions, so their precise construction cannot be stated self-containedly.
